digest.component_or_area: test suite reliability oracles (subprocess and network timeouts)
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted uses a 15-second real loopback server and should be reduced to inject a 1-second low-speed window while maintaining above-floor byte transfer semantics

test_read_retried_then_terminal consumes ~9 seconds across real child processes with production-scale retry sleeps and should inject sub-second call/grace/drain values while recording the logical [2,4] schedule without sleeping
ACLI read-retry sentinel must launch exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real process sessions, record every spawned PID, and verify all child processes are absent after terminal failure using polling
production timeout defaults, stall window, grace, drain, attempt count, and backoff schedule must remain unchanged in bytes
both test files must complete in low single-digit seconds per target test without adding brittle wall-clock pass thresholds
